rationale: Access is granted only after the analyst's identity is verified, which is authentication.
Only a payroll administrator may modify tax and pay-grade tables, restricting who can change data.
The user's identity is verified through a master secret to unlock the store; no explicit data-protection goal is stated.
Login name and secret are checked against the registered account before access, which is authentication.
A keyed MAC on logs makes unauthorised edits detectable, protecting integrity.
Rejects inconsistent or invalid reservation data, which is validation of data coherence with no attack mentioned.
Tamper-detection marking must stay verifiable despite deliberate stripping attempts, covering detection of alteration and resistance to deliberate attack.
A digest comparison detects a modified extension package and blocks installation, which is integrity checking.
Clinician identity must be established by credential check before access, and entry is denied otherwise.
Timestamps or counters let the receiver discard repeated updates, which is replay protection.
Format and checksum validation of the account number ensures data accuracy, with no attack mentioned.
Staff are identified at sign-in by a secret code checked against the registered one.
Validates format and precision of transfer data before recording, ensuring data accuracy.
A decoy endpoint that raises alerts and blocks the source detects and contains attackers.
Salary files are sent only over an encrypted protocol, protecting them from disclosure.
Overwriting memory that held balances prevents data leaking to other processes.
Symmetric encryption makes stored results readable only by key holders.
A checksum lets any alteration of object files be detected, which is integrity.
The balance must be unreadable and unalterable by external devices except via defined commands.
Limits an authenticated session to one workstation and rejects concurrent sign-ins with the same credentials; whether this aims to resist credential abuse is not stated.
The owner must be able to verify stored snapshots are unchanged, which is integrity verification.
Stateful connection tracking that drops non-matching packets blocks illegitimate network traffic.
The verification code detects modification of transaction data in transit and the payment is declined.
Only the administrator may undo a configuration change, restricting who can modify device state.
Personal data needs consent before sharing (privacy), and exfiltration through compromised accounts must be detected and blocked.
Messages that would expose account holder details contrary to privacy rules are suppressed, protecting privacy.
Idle sessions are terminated to prevent hijacking, limiting exposure to an attacker.
Mismatched integrity codes flag corrupted data and trigger correction of affected records.
A digital signature makes post-signing modification of firmware detectable; origin verification is not stated.
Verifying the signature against the holder's registered key confirms the instruction's origin and that it was not altered.
A MAC with a key held only by the communicating servers detects modification and implies the files come from a legitimate peer.
